name: Synthetic Dreams: Falling
source:
The main character is an ordinary guy living a modest life.

He is a recluse, but this does not prevent him from having a side job.

He has been playing the computer game "RtN" for 3 years already, and during this time he has not changed his feelings. Yes, he loves the video game character. Every day, he hopes that he will finally meet her.

The dream comes true and he meets her, but some kind of devilry begins to happen around, which the main character will have to deal with.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230911181531/https://recnil.itch.io/sd-falling]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
主角是一名过着清贫生活的普通男子。

他深居简出，不过，这并不妨碍他做些兼职。

他已经玩了三年电脑游戏《RtN》，在这段时间里，心意始终未变。没错，他爱上了一名游戏角色。每一天，他都盼着终于能与她相见。

梦想成真，他真的遇见了她。然而，周围也开始发生某种诡异的事情，等待主角前去应对。

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230911181531/https://recnil.itch.io/sd-falling]Itch.io[/url]]
